summary: groupby groups consecutive items with equal keys.
documentation: groupby groups consecutive items with equal keys. It does not collect every occurrence of a key across the whole input. Each group iterator shares the underlying input, so consume it before advancing.
inputs: An iterable and optional key function.
caution: Sorting first changes the meaning when the task concerns runs in the original sequence. Materialize or consume each group immediately.
scenarios: Summarize consecutive machine states as runs.
Compress repeated status labels in an ordered activity history.
Count contiguous batches in a production log.
title: Count consecutive status runs
problem: Input is an array of status strings in recorded order. Return [status, runLength] for each consecutive run. The same status appearing again later must form a separate run. Preserve original order.
goal: Use itertools.groupby() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use groupby without sorting, and count each group before moving on.
